resources.string: Your city, one trusted taxi away
Choose your pickup, review the fare, and request a licensed taxi with clear trip updates.
Manage verification, availability, offers, rides, and earnings from one focused workspace.
A taxi following a highlighted city route

Sign in to complete driver verification and manage availability.
